prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one detailed full-body 2D fighting-game enemy sprite.
Reference image: supplied Mass Effect 3 ARMOURED Reaper Brute textured in-engine model turnaround by BioWare character artist Rion Swanson. The six figures are views of one model. Reproduce this model as faithfully as possible, not the unarmoured Brute.
Subject: a single MASS EFFECT 3 Brute, the massive hunched krogan/turian Reaper creature shown in the reference. Preserve the enormous rounded shoulders and forward-leaning torso, small elongated plated head on a short cable-filled neck, tall fan of pale bony spines rising along the upper back, mottled muted brown-purple skin, dark ribbed cables and small cold-blue circular implants. Preserve the dull grey segmented armor over chest, belly, pelvis, knees and shins, heavy mechanical toes with pointed claws. Critical asymmetry: the creature's ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm/hand is the huge integrated armored pincer/club; the other arm is smaller. Keep the reference anatomy, armor plate outlines and joints; no extra horns, limbs, teeth or accessories.
Pose: one complete creature in a heavy steady idle stance, head and body angled toward screen-right, three-quarter side view that keeps the giant right-side pincer readable. Slight bend at the knees, both feet on the same implied baseline. A static preparation pose without an opponent or action scene. Preserve intact surfaces shown in the source; no added injury.
Style: realistic detailed HD pre-rendered game sprite, neutral upper-left light that clearly reveals original materials and avoids fantasy styling. Preserve the original model's proportions and broad silhouette rather than giving it human bodybuilding anatomy.
Output: one figure only on genuine transparent background; full skull, back spines, both arms, entire legs and every toe visible, with generous clear margins on all sides. No floor, cast shadow, landscape, glow haze, text, watermark, logo, collage or model sheet.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: image 1, the single generated armored Mass Effect 3 Brute. Supporting canonical reference: image 2, the BioWare in-engine Brute turnaround.
Make ONE targeted correction: restore the low, deeply hunched posture and compact body proportions from image 2. Image 1 stands too upright and has legs that read too long. Lean the massive torso forward, round the huge shoulders, lower the small plated head to approximately the shoulder level, and shorten the apparent legs by matching the original model's bent knees and low hip placement. Keep the arched spine fan, heavy shoulder mass and small elongated head in their exact reference relationship. Keep the creature facing screen-right and keep the gigantic integrated pincer on its ANATOMICAL RIGHT arm, clearly visible toward the viewer. Its smaller opposite hand and both feet must remain visible.
Preserve everything else from image 1: character identity, existing armor design and all panel seams, grey metal material, brown-purple skin, dark cables, blue mechanical implants, claws, worn textures and neutral studio illumination. Use the turnaround to correct proportions and posture only; do not redesign or add details.
One full-body static creature, no opponent or violent action. Leave generous transparent space around the complete back spines, pincer and feet. Genuine transparent background, no scenery, floor, shadows, glow haze, typography, logos, model-sheet grid or second figure. The result should match the original ME3 model's strongly stooped silhouette as closely as possible.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one HD full-body sprite for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-game annex.
Reference image: the supplied BIOWARE Mass Effect 3 Marauder model turnaround from its character artist Rion Swanson. All five figures in it are different angles of the SAME design. Generate one figure only.
Subject: a Reaper Marauder from MASS EFFECT 3, based precisely on the textured model in the reference. Preserve its tall lean turian body, native bent turian leg structure and clawed feet; weathered oxidized steel-grey armor, rib-cage chest frame with orange-red inner material, shoulder shells with circular mechanical sockets, circular elbow and knee fittings, numerous dark ribbed cables flowing from the neck down the back and into the waist. Reproduce the distinctive narrow turian skull/face frame, paired swept-back cranial blades and little round white-blue optical lenses; keep the exact reference head profile, not a human skull or a fantasy demon.
Pose/view: one full body in a controlled idle combat stance facing screen-right in three-quarter side view. Empty hands slightly forward, no invented rifle or blade. Preserve the asymmetries and panel arrangement visible in the turnaround. Keep intact body materials as shown, no new injury, no scene of violence.
Style: faithful realistic HD pre-rendered game asset with fine mechanical detail, restrained studio lighting from upper left, clear silhouette, same proportions and color distribution as the original model, no chibi or exaggerated redesign.
Framing/output: portrait composition with the ENTIRE subject visible from cranial blades to claws, at least five percent blank margin above and below and around hands. Actual transparent background with a clean alpha edge. No floor or ground shadow, backdrop, glow cloud, text, logos, interface, labels, collage or multiple views. One character per image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-body HD combat sprite for Mass Effect Armax.
Reference image: the supplied textured BioWare Mass Effect 3 Phantom turnaround, five views of one complete armor model. This is a canonical model reference, not the desired multi-view layout.
Subject: ONE adult CERBERUS PHANTOM from MASS EFFECT 3 in the exact closed-helmet outfit of the reference. Preserve the entirely enclosed black and worn white-grey helmet, angular small dark visor with very fine red slits, large circular earpiece vents and round lower mask fittings. Preserve the white/grey upper armor plates over black ribbed flexible undersuit, black abdomen segmentation, straps, tall dark armored boots and the exact asymmetrical yellow markings. The yellow stripe runs on the character's anatomical RIGHT shoulder and forearm, with the right glove yellow; the character's left thigh has the three horizontal dark/yellow straps. Keep the actual armor shapes and realistic adult proportions of the supplied model; no exposed skin, no bare face, no added decorative fantasy armor.
Pose and camera: one figure in a compact balanced guard facing screen-right at a readable three-quarter side angle, hands empty and raised modestly in front of torso, knees slightly bent. No sword or gun because this reference provides none; do not invent an equipment variant.
Style: faithful high-detail realistic rendered sprite with accurate panel seams, textures, material colors and silhouette; neutral soft upper-left studio light. Avoid pin-up posing, anime, chibi, sketch or pixel art.
Composition/output: show the entire helmet, both complete hands, legs and both boots with five percent clear margin around the figure. Genuine transparent background, clean alpha. No floor, shadow, colored halo, environment, text, branding, interface, grid, collage or second figure.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single high-resolution full-body character sprite for Mass Effect Armax, detailed realistic pre-rendered game art.
Reference image: supplied Mass Effect 2 Alternate Appearance Pack 2 promotional render. Reproduce ONLY GRUNT, the heavy krogan at the RIGHT of the image, not the two other figures.
Primary request: Grunt in the exact ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 2 heavy krogan armor shown in this reference. One complete heavily built adult krogan in a steady combat-ready stance, facing screen-right at a three-quarter side angle. Preserve the huge high shoulder/hump silhouette, broad pale-grey bony cranial plates with the reference branching pattern, small deep-set eyes, wide krogan jaw inside its protective lower face brace. Preserve the actual armor's dark graphite and gunmetal panels, bright worn-silver rounded shoulder rim, broad black chest plate with the precise pale four-stripe krogan emblem, round luminous center node, repeated pale cyan rib lights, thick rounded elbow and thigh plates, circular joints, heavy knee protection and broad clawed armored feet. His reinforced head collar is fitted around the skull exactly as in the reference, open at the face; do not add a smooth human helmet or invent a visor covering his eyes. Keep native krogan anatomy and digit count faithful.
Pose: compact open unarmed guard with both forearms forward, stable wide stance, whole head, hump, hands, legs and toes visible. Preserve reference costume proportions and mass; no gun or added equipment.
Style: highly detailed realistic materials with a readable silhouette, same HD rendered sprite direction as the existing Armax assets. Neutral upper-left studio light. Avoid cartoon, anime, pixel art and fantasy redesign.
Output: portrait image with clear margins around the entire single figure, genuine transparent background and clean alpha. No floor, shadow, environment, labels, text, logo, UI, collage or second figure.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: image 1, the single Grunt AAP2 sprite. Canonical reference: image 2, the ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 2 promotional sheet; Grunt is the large krogan on the right.
Make one precise missing-equipment correction: restore the PAIR OF SLIM DIAGONAL PALE-CYAN-LIT METAL ATTACHMENTS beside Grunt's eyes that are visible on the promotional head model in image 2. Match their actual angular shapes, locations and attachment to the existing cheek/helmet assembly. They flank the eyes; keep his eyes and central face visible. They are not a continuous sunglasses visor. Use the reference's open-face helmet arrangement exactly.
Keep the rest of image 1 unchanged as much as possible: Grunt's identity, cranial plate pattern, original face, body proportions, neutral standing pose, head facing screen-right, large hump, heavy graphite/silver armor, pale chest emblem, cyan rib lights, both gloves, legs and clawed armored feet. Preserve all armor seams, material detail and neutral lighting. No alternate helmet, no weapons, no other costume changes.
Return one complete figure with actual transparent background. Entire head, hump, fingers and toes visible. No floor, shadow, environment, colored halo, labels, logos, text, grid or second figure.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single high-resolution full-body character sprite for Mass Effect Armax, realistic detailed pre-rendered game art.
Reference image: the supplied ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 1 promotional image. Reproduce ONLY THANE KRIOS, the green drell figure at the center wearing dark red glasses. The neighboring Jack and Garrus are not part of this asset.
Primary request: Thane Krios in his exact Mass Effect 2 Alternate Appearance Pack 1 costume, one complete figure standing in a controlled combat-ready stance facing screen-right, three-quarter side view. Keep his slender adult drell anatomy, green textured head, raised cranial scale pattern, ridged red-brown side-neck membranes, narrow blood-red reflective sunglasses and stern face. Preserve the exact burgundy/dark-maroon and charcoal long-tail uniform in the reference: angular red shoulder panels, black ribbed side fabric, silver segmented center chest/abdomen panel, silver forearm inserts, long split coat tails, black gloves, fitted red legs with circular knee details and dark shoes with silver inset. Use the actual reference silhouette, colors, seams and proportions; add no alternative armor, weapons or costume decoration.
Framing: head, both complete hands, all coat tails and both shoes visible with clear transparent margins. A single figure only, relaxed bent knees and hands raised into a compact unarmed guard, body facing right. No panels, no additional views.
Lighting: neutral soft studio illumination from upper-left, preserve material detail without colored rim-light. Realistic anatomy and textile/metal detail, not pixel art, chibi, cel shading or a sketch.
Output: portrait canvas, genuine transparent background, clean silhouette alpha, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no scenery, text, title, watermark, logo or interface. Preserve the recognizable licensed character identity and this precise DLC outfit as faithfully as possible.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: image 1, the single transparent Thane Krios AAP1 combat sprite. Canonical costume reference: image 2, the ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 1 promotional sheet; Thane is the central green drell wearing red sunglasses.
Perform a precise costume correction only: shorten the two burgundy side tails of the coat to match the actual garment in image 2. The first sprite's long pointed tails extend too low toward/below the knees. In the canonical promotional model, those side coat panels finish higher, along the thigh above the knee details. Match their exact shape and relative endpoint against the hip and knee positions shown in image 2.
Keep all other pixels/appearance as stable as possible: same adult Thane identity, head and red glasses, head angle, guarded hands, leg stance, full-body scale, torso armor, colors, panel texture, gloves, boots, upper-left lighting and existing transparency. Do not change the silver center abdomen panel or shorten the legs. Do not add weapons, new clothing, another character or scenery.
One full-body figure on genuine transparent background with complete head, hands and boots inside the canvas. No text, labels, watermarks, logos, grid, ground, shadow or colored halo.
